topics.new_development: American Metal said NOAA certified two exploration license applications for parts of the Clarion-Clipperton Zone, and NOAA will now complete an environmental study.
topics.title: American Metal clears a seabed mining step
topics.summary: American Metal said US regulators certified two applications from its subsidiaries to explore for minerals in the Pacific’s Clarion-Clipperton Zone. The company said the next step is an environmental study by NOAA before any exploration licenses can be finalized.
topics.detail: The applications cover 104,000 square miles in international waters, the company said. NOAA’s review may include a public hearing. American Metal said the exploration license would let it study the area before seeking a commercial mining permit.

sources.title: American Metal says US seabed mining exploration licence application advances

topics.title: So stays sole leader after round seven
topics.summary: GM Wesley So remained sole leader after a turnaround win in the 2026 U.S. Chess Championship. In the women’s event, Li and Lee stayed at the top after the latest round.
topics.detail: Chess.com said the 2026 U.S. Chess Championship and U.S. Women’s Chess Championship are taking place in St. Louis from October 9 to 22. The round report also said the women’s leaders were Li and Lee after round seven.

sources.title: So Sole Leader After Turnaround Win; Li And Lee Lead Women's

topics.title: Caruana wins Titled Tuesday
topics.summary: GM Fabiano Caruana won Titled Tuesday on October 13 while on an off day in the U.S. Championship. Chess.com said he beat GM Nihal Sarin in a key 10th-round matchup.
topics.detail: The report said Caruana was sharing the lead in the 2026 U.S. Championship at the time. It also said the online event came during a break in the St. Louis tournament schedule.

sources.title: Caruana Wins Titled Tuesday On Day Off In U.S. Championship

topics.title: Movahed takes Freestyle Friday first
topics.summary: GM Sina Movahed won Freestyle Friday on October 16 after a 7/7 start. Chess.com said he finished alone in first place on nine points.

sources.title: Movahed Returns To Familiar Freestyle Friday First Position

topics.title: Study revisits fusion ignition sequence
topics.summary: Scientists reported calculations suggesting a different heating order could make fusion ignition more efficient. The work says heating plasma before increasing its density may reduce the energy needed for self-sustaining fusion.
topics.detail: The study was published through ScienceDaily and described research from Princeton Plasma Physics Laboratory. It says the approach has not yet been demonstrated experimentally. The report says the calculations point to a potentially more efficient route than the traditional density-first sequence.

sources.title: Scientists may have found a shortcut to fusion energy
